meta.name: scienceworld-container-transfer
meta.description: Moves a substance or object from one container to another (e.g., moving lead to a metal pot). Use this skill when you need to prepare materials for processing, such as transferring a substance into a heat-resistant container before heating, or reorganizing materials between vessels for mixing or measurement.

copy.tagline: 在容器间转移物质或物体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在实验或加工前将物质从一个容器移到另一个容器
copy.tagline_en: Transfer substances or objects between containers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to move substances between containers for lab work or processing

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 可以帮你将物质或物体从一个容器转移到另一个容器，比如把铅从锡杯移到金属锅，为加热、混合或测量做准备。
howto.when: 当你需要准备材料进行加工，例如将物质转移到耐热容器中加热，或在容器之间重新整理材料以进行混合或测量时。

say.text: 将铅从锡杯转移到金属锅里。
把红色液体从烧杯倒进量筒。
将沙子从小桶移到大桶。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can move a substance or object from one container to another, e.g., moving lead from a tin cup to a metal pot, preparing for heating, mixing, or measurement.
howto.when_en: When you need to prepare materials for processing, such as transferring a substance into a heat-resistant container before heating, or reorganizing materials between vessels for mixing or measurement.

say_en.text: Move the lead from the tin cup to the metal pot.
Pour the red liquid from the beaker into the graduated cylinder.
say_en.note: Claude will perform the liquid transfer.

say_en.text: Shift the sand from the small bucket to the large bucket.
say_en.note: Claude will perform the solid transfer.
